authority: MECHANISM 4 — RESEARCH QUEUE. Active queue: only active items. During sweeps and all bootstrap steps the queue is inactive for everything except inaccessible wall sources — all other discoveries are followed immediately. During operational work it captures discoveries genuinely unrelated to the current task that would derail it if pursued now.

fair_service.rule: one fair FIFO slice reserved in each cycle of three service slices; the other two may use the adopted urgency/coverage/impact ordering
fair_service.cycle_persistence_note: cycle position persisted across turns including reduced-budget turns
